articles.title: My AI agents found an unmapped Maya site?
articles.summary: AI agents analyzed public lidar data overnight and found a Maya site under the jungle. It turned out archaeologists had mapped it already, but it wasn't in Mexico's official register yet.

articles.title: Smart home devices should work without the internet
